beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows access: The decisive technology is not the door but the stack of schedule, accreditation, invitation and identity checks that precedes it.
beats.onScreen: Then: FHCM coordinates Paris Fashion Week and publishes the official calendar; its history traces the federation to the Chambre Syndicale founded in 1868.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: FHCM coordinates Paris Fashion Week and publishes the official calendar; its history traces the federation to the Chambre Syndicale founded in 1868. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The public calendar, accreditation portal and institutional designations are related but distinct permissions: visibility is not admission.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No public source reviewed establishes the guest-list software, identity checks or security stack for every forthcoming house presentation.
